title: fix(objectql)!: a running install or reload is asked the record-currency follow door once, at the end of its restore run
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续(PR #32474 / #32369 拆出的半张)。reach: 具名真实生产者 — 运行中安装与重载(`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` → `manifest` 服务 → `registerApp`)。

## What

After the seal (`kernel:bootstrapped`), the `manifest` service registers every body of an artifact, then the residual's top-level objects, in ONE `restoringOnRefusal` run (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`, the #31564 block; each `registerApp` joins it). Nested plugins (step 7 of `registerPackageBody`) register inside the same run. None of that unit is asked #32312's record-currency follow door (`againstRegistry`), so a running install whose follow pair is really bad is registered and answered "installed".

Card #32369's scope addition ({{WAS:2026-11-10T23:47Z}}, comment 6782529809) put this half on #32369. PR #32474's first round judged it per body (step 2c at the end of each `registerPackageBody`); the contract review (6810655259 round 2, round 1 F1) showed the unit is smaller than the unit the tree registers, so a valid artifact whose pair spans members was refused. Step 2c was taken out and the half moved here.

## Acceptance

- The follow door is asked once, at the end of the OUTERMOST restore run, over every body, the residual's objects and the nested plugins' objects the run registered. A refusal undoes the whole run (as the run already does for other refusals) and reaches the install report as a 4xx (`marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` answers a 4xx register refusal as `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`).
- From 6782529809: a package whose own `objectExtensions` supplies the parent's code field still installs; the same when the field comes from a LATER member of the artifact or from its residual.
- A reload that adds the code field in a later member and makes an earlier body's child follow it still reloads (the parent judged is the new one, not the version that served).
- A package with a really bad follow pair (in a body, in the residual, or in a nested plugin) reports the refusal in the install report, and the reload keeps the version that served.
- Unmoved: cold boot (no follow door before the seal), stored-row hydration, `restoreArtifactRegistryView`, draft save (body-only).
- Docblocks: `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` and `packages/objectql/src/record-currency-aggregate-door.ts` still say the batch writers and `registerApp` hear a refusal "only as a log line" and that `againstRegistry` is "not a batch publish, an install or a migration pass". After #32474 the batch-writer half is false; after this card the install half is. Rewrite both to the tree.
- BREAKING (narrowing: a running install that registered before is refused) ⇒ changeset major note and the maintainer's word before queueing.

## Order

Blocked-by #32474 (it lands the batch writers' half and the `objectRegistrationRefusal` answer this card reuses). Serial after the open PRs on `objectql/src/plugin.ts` / `registry.ts`: #32357, #32306, #32214, #32327 — take it after those land or rebase on them; ⛔ do not race them.

## 业务理由

谁受益: 在运行中的实例上安装或重载包的管理员。场景: 包的 `record` 跟随对确实错误(金额跟随一个父对象上不存在的币种代码字段)。不做: 安装报「成功」,币种错配的记录照常写入,直到读取或汇总时才暴露;而批量写入器(#32474)已在同一情况下拒收,两条路径对同一元数据给出不同答案。

## 读者

domain:server 席位(server seat A/B),认领后派 os-dev;起点 `plugin.ts` #31564 块与 `engine-registration.ts` step 2b/7。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue registerApp restoringOnRefusal` → 3 hits (#32369 open = parent of this split; #31564 closed = the restore run itself; #28697 closed, unrelated). `is:issue registerApp follow door` → 65 hits; open ones are #32369 and #20966 (seat post) only. No duplicate.
